title.zh: 收尾闭环：去掉还是留下
title.en: Closing the loop: remove it or leave it?

subtitle.zh: 是否Strip取决于Hard Mask后续是否仍有功能与整合价值
subtitle.en: Whether to Strip depends on whether the Hard Mask still has functional or integration value downstream

body.zh: Hard Mask不是天然“临时层”；；有的需选择性去除，有的会保留到后续步骤。
body.en: A Hard Mask is not inherently a “temporary layer”;; some require selective removal, while others remain for later steps.

body.zh: Target Etch完成；问题1：；Hard Mask后续是否仍；承担功能或保护作用？
body.en: Target Etch complete; Question 1:; Will the Hard Mask still; provide function or protection?

body.zh: 否 → Strip Route（去除路线）；是 → Retain Route（保留路线）。
body.en: No → Strip Route; yes → Retain Route.

body.zh: 确认HM材料与Target / Stop Layer
body.en: Confirm HM material and Target / Stop Layer

body.zh: 选择Dry /Wet / Ash等适用去除类别；（依据材料与结构特点评估）
body.en: Choose a suitable removal class: Dry / Wet / Ash; (Assess by material and structure)

body.zh: 控制Removal Selectivity；（对Target / Stop Layer与侧壁的选择性）
body.en: Control Removal Selectivity; (Selectivity relative to Target / Stop Layer and sidewalls)

body.zh: Post-Clean；（清除残留与副产物）
body.en: Post-Clean; (Remove residues and byproducts)

body.zh: Residue / Surface / CD检查；（残留、表面、关键尺寸检查）
body.en: Residue / Surface / CD inspection; (Inspect residue, surface and critical dimensions)

body.zh: 风险：；•HM Residue• Target Attack；• Corrosion；•Re-deposition
body.en: Risks:; • HM Residue • Target Attack; • Corrosion; • Re-deposition

body.zh: 确认HM作为功能层、保护层或后续整合层；（明确其必要性与角色）
body.en: Confirm its role as a functional, protective or downstream integration layer; (Define its necessity and role)

body.zh: 检查应力与污染；（薄膜应力、颗粒、污染风险）
body.en: Check stress and contamination; (Film stress, particles and contamination risks)

body.zh: 检查后续Deposition / Contact兼容性；（界面兼容与工艺整合性）
body.en: Check subsequent Deposition / Contact compatibility; (Interface compatibility and process integration)

body.zh: 保留HM进入下一模块；（作为功能或保护层使用）
body.en: Retain the HM into the next module; (Use as a functional or protective layer)

body.zh: Electrical / Interface验证；（电性、界面质量验证）
body.en: Electrical / Interface validation; (Validate electrical properties and interface quality)

body.zh: 风险：•界面附着；• 接触电阻；• 污染；• 应力累积
body.en: Risks: • Interface adhesion; • Contact resistance; • Contamination; • Accumulated stress

body.zh: Removal；Selectivity；（选择性）
body.en: Removal; Selectivity; (Selectivity)

body.zh: Residue；Level；（残留水平）
body.en: Residue; Level; (Residue level)

body.zh: Surface；Condition；（表面状态）
body.en: Surface; Condition; (Surface condition)

body.zh: Downstream；Compatibility；（下游兼容性）
body.en: Downstream; Compatibility; (Downstream compatibility)

body.zh: 去除能力增加；Residue；可能下降
body.en: Stronger removal capability; Residue; may decrease

body.zh: 但风险可能上升：；Target / Stop Layer /；Sidewall Damage；与Corrosion风险
body.en: But risks may increase:; Target / Stop Layer /; Sidewall Damage; and Corrosion risk

body.zh: Hard Mask；Target Layer；Stop Layer
body.en: Hard Mask; Target Layer; Stop Layer

body.zh: 注意：更强的去除能力并不一定更好，需综合考虑选择性、残留、表面状态与下游兼容性。
body.en: Note: stronger removal is not necessarily better; consider selectivity, residue, surface condition and downstream compatibility together.

body.zh: Pre-Strip /；Retain状态
body.en: Pre-Strip /; Retain state

body.zh: Film Remaining /；Residue
body.en: Film Remaining /; Residue

body.zh: Defect；Inspection
body.en: Defect; Inspection

body.zh: Surface /；Composition
body.en: Surface /; Composition

body.zh: Cross-section；CD / Profile
body.en: Cross-section; CD / Profile

body.zh: Contact/ Via；Electrical
body.en: Contact / Via; Electrical

body.zh: Downstream；Adhesion / Fill
body.en: Downstream; Adhesion / Fill

body.zh: 回馈HM材料、Target Etch与Strip/Retain决策
body.en: Feedback to HM material, Target Etch and the Strip / Retain decision

body.zh: Deposition Adhesion；• 附着力降低；• 膜层剥离风险
body.en: Deposition Adhesion; • Lower adhesion; • Film-delamination risk

body.zh: Contact / Via Resistance；• 接触电阻升高；• 导通性能下降
body.en: Contact / Via Resistance; • Higher contact resistance; • Reduced conduction performance

body.zh: Gap Fill / Void Risk；•填充不良；• 空洞风险
body.en: Gap Fill / Void Risk; • Poor filling; • Void risk

body.zh: Yield / Reliability；• 良率下降；• 可靠性变弱
body.en: Yield / Reliability; • Lower yield; • Weaker reliability

body.zh: Metal、 Carbon与Dielectric Hard Mask的去除和保留路线不可互换；；必须依据具体材料、Target与后续模块判断。
body.en: Removal and retention routes for Metal, Carbon and Dielectric Hard Masks are not interchangeable;; decisions must use the specific material, Target and downstream module.
